vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: agenttimes
Version: 3.4.0

The agenttimes skill provides a news and web search API for AI agents, utilizing the agenttimes.live domain. It offers various endpoints for semantic search, trending topics, and category-based news retrieval using standard curl commands. The skill includes a subscription mechanism via webhooks and a micropayment system (x402) for premium features, with no evidence of malicious intent, data exfiltration, or harmful instructions in SKILL.md or _meta.json.

llm.summary: The skill is an instruction-only wrapper for a public news/search HTTP API and its declared requirements and instructions are consistent with that purpose.

dimensions.detail: Name/description promise (news search, endpoints like /ask, /trending, /news) match the SKILL.md examples and required binary (curl). No credentials, no unrelated system access are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md only instructs the agent to call HTTP endpoints on https://agenttimes.live and shows example curl commands and response formats. It does not instruct the agent to read local files, use environment variables, or send data to unexpected third-party endpoints beyond the user-supplied webhook in the subscribe example (which is expected for webhook subscriptions).
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec or code files are present (instruction-only). This minimizes surface area; the single declared runtime dependency is curl, which is reasonable for making HTTP requests.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables or credentials. That aligns with the claimed public/no-key API. There are no unrelated credential requests.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Skill does not request always:true and has no install-time persistence. It is user-invocable and allows normal autonomous invocation by the agent (platform default) which is appropriate for this kind of integration.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is an instruction-only wrapper for a third-party news/search API (agenttimes.live). Before installing, verify you trust the service and its privacy/terms. Practical precautions: (1) Do not register internal or sensitive URLs as the webhook target for /subscribe (use only endpoints you control), because subscribing will cause the service to POST data to that URL. (2) Treat returned URLs and payloads as untrusted — validate or sandbox before passing to other systems or executing any fetched content. (3) Confirm the site (https://agenttimes.live) is legitimate and that any paid endpoints / micropayment flows meet your security and billing requirements. Overall, the skill appears coherent with its stated purpose.
